# KafkaBrokerMetadataLagging

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-kraft](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-kraft/) | 5m / 1m |

**Summary:** Broker <kafka_broker> applies metadata more than 30 s late

The broker lags behind the KRaft metadata log (Kafka writes a no-op record every 500 ms, so the lag is normally below a second). It serves stale leadership information: clients see NOT_LEADER errors and timeouts.

## Impact

The broker serves stale metadata: clients are redirected to old leaders and see NOT_LEADER_OR_FOLLOWER errors and timeouts.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · KRaft → Metadata apply lag per broker; broker logs for metadata loader errors; broker CPU/GC.

## Mitigation

- Restart the broker if it does not catch up; investigate metadata apply errors.

## Expression

```promql
max by (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (kafka_server_brokermetadatametrics_last_applied_record_lag_ms < 86400000) > 30000
```
